name: window
title: Window
description: The frame of an application around a screenshot, a demo or a terminal.
use: A screenshot, a short demo or a few lines of a terminal shown as an application window. The frame is decoration: its marks are not buttons.

instead.when: A picture needs a caption and no application frame
A window opens over the page and takes focus
Lines of code need no frame
What is shown is the screen of a phone

classes.name: window
classes.description: The frame: a lifted sheet with a 12px corner that clips what it holds

classes.name: window-flat
classes.description: One contour and no shadow, for a window on a tray or in a dense page

classes.name: window-bar
classes.description: The bar across the top: marks at the start, a title or an address in the middle, room for a control at the end

classes.name: window-controls
classes.description: Three marks at the start of the bar, drawn from one empty element; hide it with aria-hidden="true"

classes.name: window-title
classes.description: A title in the middle of the bar, on one line

classes.name: window-address
classes.description: An address in a small well in the middle of the bar, instead of a title

classes.name: window-end
classes.description: What stands at the end of the bar

classes.name: window-body
classes.description: What the window shows: an image, a video, a pre or a div. It has no padding
